branchReconciliation.integrationProof: The accepted K4c delivery is in the base history and its K4c evidence files are present at this base with the exact pinned digests; the accepted branch tip's K4c payload was verified byte-identical to the delivered commit by an empty file-set diff on this clone.

The accepted K4d delivery is in the base history and its K4d evidence files (bounded external-wait record and generated/claude receipts) are present at this base with the exact pinned digests; the accepted branch tip's K4d payload was verified byte-identical to the delivered commit by an empty file-set diff on this clone.

externalWaits.blocker: No publisher identity or ClawHub listing is established, so the anonymous OpenClaw search/install/use/negative/remove/zero-residue readback cannot be performed.
externalWaits.resumeAction: Owner publishes the MIT-0 generated kaleidosphere skill bundle from the official ClawHub account, then performs the anonymous OpenClaw search/install/use/negative/remove readback with zero-residue verification.

externalWaits.blocker: Owner authority and a verified publisher identity are not established in the official Codex portal UI, and no live same-digest portal submission or live anonymous directory readback has been performed.
externalWaits.resumeAction: Owner resumes in the official portal UI to verify owner authority and publisher identity.

externalWaits.blocker: Owner authority and a verified publisher identity are not established in the official Claude Code marketplace UI, and no live same-digest marketplace submission or live anonymous directory readback has been performed.
externalWaits.resumeAction: Owner resumes in the official Claude Code marketplace UI to verify owner authority and publisher identity before any submission or terms acceptance.

deterministicRebuildFromCanonicalBytes.proof: tests/agent-skill-distribution.test.mjs rebuilds every host view from the canonical skill bytes plus package version and asserts byte and digest equality; tests/release.test.mjs asserts the three v0.26.0 distribution archives and their SHA256 sidecars against sha256sum -c.

archivesAndSidecarsOnRegularLatestReleas.note: The local release build deterministically emits the distribution archives and SHA256 sidecars. Whether a public regular Latest release carries them is an external fact not verified on this base.

publicCatalogAnonymousReadback.note: No anonymous search/install/use/negative/remove/zero-residue readback exists for any host; every per-child publicListingClaim is false.

externalWaitsExactOneStepResume.note: Each external wait is nonterminal (satisfied false) and records exactly one bounded resume action.

k4eSerialAfterK4aAndIntentBound.note: K4e was implemented only after K4a reached source-local terminal, and the six External API v2 runtime intents are exact and unwidened with runtimeDispatch false.
